name: Two-Factor Disabled
description: Sent when an administrator turns off two-factor authentication on a player account.
subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off on your {{serverName}} account
heading: Two-factor authentication turned off
body: An administrator of {{serverName}} turned off two-factor authentication on your account, {{displayName}}. You can turn it back on from your Security page whenever you like.
text: An administrator turned off two-factor authentication on your {{serverName}} account. You can turn it back on from your Security page.
footerNote: If you did not expect this, contact the server administrator.
